description: IRVE statique (organisation Qwello ) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Qwello . Consolidated file of the Bornes de RechQwello manufactures, installs and operates public charging stations for European cities and metropolises. Qwello manages public charging free of charge for the city and pays a fee for the operation of parking spaces in road and public parking for Electric Vehicles Updated on 17/04/2026. Coverage: Qwello . The portal shows the English title as "Static IRVE (Qwello ) Organization" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Qwello . The listing shows 6 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2026-07-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
